Austrian Association for American Studies (AAAS)
Maga. Sonja Lenz MA (Johannes Kepler Universität)
The PROVE project (Promoting Values Education in South Caucasus Higher Education Institutions) study visit has officially kicked off at the University of Western Macedonia (UoWM)!

Our first day was packed with productive energy as we held our Consortium Meeting. Partners from Georgia, Armenia, and Europe came together to share updates on project implementation and midterm reporting. It was inspiring to see the progress made by each institution -TeSaU, CU, YSU, AvaKE, ASPU, PHDL, ISU, and our hosts at UoWM - in integrating values education into higher education.
